title: It's My Dream, So I Won't Give Up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The tryouts draw closer. One day, during a
trip to the shopping
district, I hear a
familiar voice.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Carrots! Get your carrots here!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, long time no see! Hehe, I'm helping
the carrot farmer sell his
stock!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: He opens a stall here in the local farmer market every once in a while, but he's got a ton of leftovers this time.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
We can sell these if we put our minds to it,
though! Who wouldn't
want a tasty carrot?

text_block_list.name: Farmer
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the thought, Urara, but that's
enough. It's my own darn
fault for bringing
so many carrots.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It'll be fine! We just gotta get people's
attention, and those carrots
will fly off the
cart! Carrots! Get your carrots here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even when faced with a literal mountain of
unsold carrots, Haru
Urara's determined
cries never waver.

text_block_list.name: Fish Stall Owner
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit, Urara! Come on, folks, we
can't let her have ALL the
fun!

text_block_list.name: Vegetable Seller
text_block_list.text:
In that case... Come and get it! I'll offer a
deal on onions and
potatoes to anyone
buying carrots! Perfect for curry or stew!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before long, the shopping district is abuzz
with activity, all thanks to
Haru Urara.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Woohoo, all the carrots are gone!

text_block_list.name: Farmer
text_block_list.text:
Who would've thought I'd sell every last
carrot... I couldn't have
asked for more.
Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
No problem! I'm just glad I could tell
people how tasty your carrots
are!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Th-there you are!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, King! Sorry, but the carrots are all
gone.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, phooey! I'm late to the party... not!
Aren't you forgetting
something? You
should be training right now!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, my bad, but the carrot farmer was
in trouble! I couldn't just
ignore him.

text_block_list.name: Farmer
text_block_list.text:
Don't be too mad at her, miss. Our little
Urara here was busy teaching
me a very
important lesson—

text_block_list.name: Farmer
text_block_list.text: To never give up, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! And I couldn't let those carrots go
to waste!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I-I haven't the slightest idea what you're
going on about...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Sigh... At least you had a reason for skipping training.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
However! You shouldn't disappear without
a word like that though!
Do you know how
worried Special Week was?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
What?! Then I better go apologize to her
right away!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait!

text_block_list.name: Fish Stall Owner
text_block_list.text:
Bahaha! Always bursting with energy, that
one. At this rate, her dream
of finishing
first isn't far off from coming true!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you didn't know? Haru Urara has
never finished first place, even
in training
or the scrimmages.

text_block_list.name: Fish Stall Owner
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but she never gives up or even gets
discouraged. She just
keeps running with a
smile on her face. Amazing, right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
As long as she keeps her head up, she still
has a chance. Of course,
an invincible
racer like me has no such worries.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thinking back, I recall Haru Urara
mentioning first place a few times,
but who
would've thought it was such a big issue
for her?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps the reason I find her so
compelling... is that steadfast
dedication
to achieving her dream.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho—H-hold on, don't ignore me! I
demand my due respect!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Phew... Let's do the dirt course next.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's you again!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Well, the tryouts aren't far off! I really
gotta kick it into gear if I
wanna take first
place!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I wonder what winning feels like...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I mean, running on its own is already so
fun. If I take first place, I bet
I'd be doing
backflips!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah! I am an Umamusume, after all! I love running, but I want to win too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And as long as I keep up my training, I'm
sure I'll take first place
someday! I won't
give up!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So I better get back to it! Up next is... the
dirt course!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara's sunny outlook continues to
shine on despite her track
record.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She comes off as a little naive, but at the
same time... I can't help but
want to see
her win.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Really?! Could you?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, to be honest, I don't really know if
I'm doing this whole
training thing right, so
having you here will be a big help!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
All right, just you watch! I'll show you what
I've got!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I quietly observe Haru Urara's practice,
my calling as a trainer is
even more
compelled to help this dreamer reach her
goal.
